Hi Karen / DevCon team,

Thanks again for agreeing to co‑host a hands‑on lab with us at DevCon. We think a practical, code-first session showing how to optimize inference throughput & cost (batching + caching + quantization tradeoffs) will drive strong attendance from platform and infra engineers.

Quick proposal: two 60‑minute sessions (same content) on different days/times to hit US east and west audiences. We want Redwood to provide the demo runner + brief walkthrough; DevCon to provide a 5‑minute context set and promo to their attendee list.

I attached three invite copy variants (short invite, technical deep dive, and exec highlight) and a segmentation spreadsheet with suggested cohorts. Asking DevCon for:
- preferred co‑host speaker and headshot (for registration page)
- any logo/badging files (png/svg) for the registration page
- confirmation of which DevCon segments we can promote to (partners list vs full attendee list)

Proposed dates (pick one pair):
- Option A: Tue, Jan 19 2027 (11:00 PT) + Thu, Jan 21 2027 (15:00 PT)
- Option B: Wed, Jan 27 2027 (10:00 PT) + Fri, Jan 29 2027 (14:00 PT)

Tracking and CTAs: we want unique UTMs per cohort and per subject-line test. Mateo, can you provision the shortlink + UTM template if Karen confirms? I included a simple tracking template in the attachments.

Attachments: hands-on-lab-invite-copy-v3.docx; segmentation-targets-202611.xlsx; tracking-utm-template.txt

If this looks good, Karen — can you confirm speaker + which option works by end of day Friday? We’ll lock the registration page and send a partner co‑promotion checklist.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
